audit.recode_to: conflict (Sapir 1965:9 theme/stem-initial stress + person-marker stress vs Creissels & Bassène 2024 'Jóola Fóoñi does not have word stress'); if the catalog privileges the most recent specialist primary, 'no-word-stress'. In no case 'fixed-dominant' with word-initial vectors 10/100/1000… — Sapir's own examples all have an unstressed prefix (ɛ-'ja-mɛn = 010).
